title: Greedy
body:
Everything requires a premium all they need is money money money for a simple to do app
Can you at least put 8 free habits like 3 are nothing not everyone have money + you can put ads for each habit i will add at least you make money i get my habit isn’t that better than 3 free habits + i really like the design but you lost me on the money point + no hate just telling the truth hope you do
Better and grow with this app
author: Meher Hadhri
